_about: ACME-KYC: soulbound W3C VC credential (program `credential`, standard UNITS-CREDENTIAL). Issued with POST /v1/token/add (NOT /token/mint). operationOverrides is stored but NOT enforced by the engine today - the credential program itself has no transfer/burn.

register.name: ACME KYC Credential
register.description: Soulbound W3C Verifiable Credential attesting that ACME completed KYC for the holder.

schema.description: Documentation only (not enforced). token/add validates credentialSubject against a closed KYC-shaped schema: id, documentType, country, faceMatchVerified, faceMatchPercentage required; domain data goes in evidence[].rawPayload.
